text:
Marta: Brainstorm: build a 1-pager battle mini-kit for SDRs + webinar hosts focused on three quick push buttons: econ, reliability, and integration risk. Keep each asset <120 chars for CTAs.
Devin: Yes. Also add 2 live-demo triggers for webinars: (1) live cost calc for a 100k-token/month app, (2) simulated failover showing fallback model.
Leo: For competitive lanes let's split messaging: Cloud-managed APIs -> pricing opaqueness + vendor lock; LLM API ]-> model access but no production routing; Infra vendors -> pure runtime, no orchestration. Short rebut lines only.
Rina: Drafting pocket lines. Tossing raw takeaways here, please chop for length:
```
Econ hook: "Same open model, 40-60% lower token spend through tunable batching + KV caching."
Reliability hook: "Cross-region fallbacks + model variants mean 99.95% app availability during infra incidents."
Integration hook: "Ship with runtime & rollouts so you don't hire a serving team — one deployment path from dev->prod."
```
Marta: Nice. Make the econ number defensible. Add a tiny footnote in slides: "based on our 4k-context benchmark, batching+cache enabled".
Devin: Webinar CTAs to A/B test: 
- CTA A: "See the live benchmark: same model, lower token costs"
- CTA B: "See how we keep latency at scale during storms"
Track by funnel_source tag.
Leo: Inbound routing draft for CRM automation (short mapping):
```
utm_campaign=econ -> SDR-econ-flow
utm_campaign=security -> AE-enterprise
webinar_attended=true -> Demo-queue
resource_download=bench -> SolutionsEng
```
Rina: Pocket rebut bullets (2 each max). Quick versions: 
- Cloud-managed: "Easy to call, hard to tune. No knobs for batching or quantization — bills surprise you."
- LLM API: "Great models, not a serving stack. You still need routing, rollbacks, and SLOs."
- Infra vendor: "Low-level libs; you still build the orchestration glue and monitoring."
Marta: Can we get 10 <120-char SDR scripts (econ/reliability/integration) + 3 slide-top hooks by EOD? I'll assemble the deck.
Devin: I'll wire the CRM tags and add quick automation snippets. Will post the mapping here when ready.
Leo: Add a single slide 'apples-to-apples' showing model, seq len, batching, and quant settings used. That prevents nitpicks.
Rina: Also adding a tiny "how we measured" note: p50/p95 latency, tokens billed, and batching config. Keep it simple.
FieldBot: @channel doc stub created: /playbooks/field-mini-kit.md. Meeting reminder set for 15m. :calendar:
Marta: Perfect. One other ask: for each pocket script include one quick objection handler and a follow-up ask. Example: "Want a 10-min calc for your usage?"
Devin: Agree. That makes SDR flows tight. I'll add a small form to the demo-queue to capture infra vs econ leads.
Leo: I'll polish the rebut lines to be less confrontational and more consultative. Drop edits in 10.
Rina: Cool — will post the first 10 scripts in the doc and ping #field-armory.
Marta: Thanks all. See you in the sync.
